scope: text, media, article, live-mode recovery, compact plugin UI, one-confirmation Android plugin entry, inbound Android share target, system share and Android/iOS WeChat bridge interaction
checks: compact plugin initial state, honest demo disclosure and keyboard skip link
compact text brand, local typography and image assets render without browser-page decoration
blank and over-limit Unicode messages fail locally without a request
a 6000-character article reaches the backend and renders its content summary
one example control cycles useful messages
real local backend closes message → possible meanings → editable reply on one page
copy uses the exact edited reply; empty edits are blocked and two failed clipboard methods leave the reply selected
pending requests lock edits and prevent duplicates; failures preserve hand-edited drafts and retry succeeds
recipient changes clear stale output and mom, dad, elder replies use correct addresses; Ctrl+Enter works
input/example changes clear stale output; unseen shares stay honest and ambiguous messages retain alternatives
malformed successful responses fail clearly without rendering garbage or losing input
input and generated HTML-like text remain text, never executable markup
320/390/1440px layouts do not overflow, mobile controls are at least 44px, reduced motion is respected
WeChat UA/touch simulation uses legacy one-tap copy when available and keeps selected-text fallback when both clipboard paths fail
configuration failure keeps live mode unavailable; local fallback and reconnect both work
configuration outages preserve edited replies and provenance; reconnect respects the established or chosen mode
tab reload restores edited reply, recipient, chosen mode and truthful LLM source without another generation
device-local history restores the selected recipient, source and edited reply without another request
refresh never stores attachment bytes and asks to reselect the file before analysing again
clear draft removes text and stored reply; malformed stored data never breaks the page
blocked browser storage keeps the full generation flow usable and explains that draft saving is unavailable
late initialization does not change an in-flight request mode or discard its completed result
configured live UI passes reply style, defaults to real generation, declares transmission and shows provenance; explicit mode changes clear stale output (mocked)
a public WeChat article uses a 60s request and shows safely rendered title, fetched body and coverage before edited copy (mocked fetch/model)
article fetch failure, missing body evidence and cancellation preserve drafts; arbitrary URLs are not presented as fetched articles
attachments stay local until submit; missing media config, unsupported files, 4/20 MiB limits and actual >60s video are rejected without uploading
an image with no text closes upload → content summary → visible evidence → edited copy, using exact base64 and a 180s media timeout (mocked model)
media processing locks attachment changes, prevents duplicate submits and supports cancellation without losing the attachment or edited draft
an expired media request preserves input and edited reply; retry succeeds (timeout clock accelerated)
media summaries and OCR stay plain text; missing summaries, template substitutions and mismatched attachment evidence never replace a valid draft
demo mode refuses media; replacing or removing an attachment clears stale analysis and resets the file picker
real MP4 metadata is previewed and video readiness is gated; video results show transcript, sampling limits and honest silent-audio status (mocked model)
attachment previews, native file picker and expandable evidence fit 320/390px screens with 44px controls
sharing is hidden without its API, in insecure contexts, or when canShare rejects/throws; unsupported paths keep an actionable copy fallback
share sends only exact edited text with click activation; duplicates and edits are locked without AI loading, and completion never claims contact delivery
AbortError explains cancellation or missing share targets and preserves the draft, source and attachment without automatic copy or retry
all system share failures explain the reported cause, preserve the exact draft and restore explicit copy without retrying
blank drafts and in-flight generation cannot share; browsers with share but no optional canShare still work
share and copy stay usable at 320/390px with 44px buttons; relationship options never become fake WeChat contacts
Android JSON bridge hides missing-app-id sharing with working copy; focus rechecks ready capability without losing edited drafts
Android shares only exact edited text and correlated ids; locks duplicates without AI loading, never claims delivery, and unknown native results ask the user to confirm in WeChat
late native share results cannot overwrite a newer handoff or an edited draft, even when the edited text returns to its original value
native errors, cancellation, thrown bridge calls and accelerated 10s timeout preserve drafts and restore copy; blank and >10240 UTF-8 bytes never post
Android plugin mode removes secondary controls and one explicit confirmation closes clipboard import → analysis → editable reply in a short viewport
Android one-confirmation flow waits for slow startup config, generates exactly once when unchanged, and cancels auto-submit after an edit
inbound text waits for explicit acceptance without analysis or draft loss; dismiss and both return paths send correlated native acknowledgements
a newer inbound share supersedes a slow attachment import without draft loss, stale acknowledgement or silent loss
same-origin token images are read locally into an attachment; MIME and byte-count mismatches preserve the existing draft and attachment without acknowledgement or AI calls
bridge-less Android fallback imports and copies normally while hiding no-op return actions and naming the system back key
iOS posts structured bridge objects and accepts CustomEvent replies; regenerated results ignore previous native callbacks
ready native WeChat and copy actions fit 320/390px with 44px targets; native SDK and callbacks are simulated, with no real message sent
no uncaught JavaScript or Content Security Policy errors across exercised flows
mediaVerification: Real local image/MP4 preview and metadata; model responses mocked, cancellation and timeout recovery exercised
